d:
The Suns defeated the Hornets, 101-96 tonight in Phoenix. Devin Booker contributed a team-high 30 points to go with 7 assists 4 three pointers and 3 steals, with Dillon Brooks of the Suns adding an additional 15 points (6-13 FG, 3-6 3P) in the game. Coby White finished with a team-high 21 points along with 3 rebounds for the Hornets in the losing effort. The Suns improve their record to 5-6 with the win, while the Hornets fall to 4-8 for the season.
